[[Helicoprion]] is an extinct cartilaginous fish(called a [[shark]] in its creature description, though it is closer to ratfish) from the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Permian Permian] period. It is characterized by its tooth whorl which is used for hunting prey. It is found in temperate and tropical [[oceans]].

As with all [[Extinction|real-world extinct creatures]], its spawning depends on settings chosen during world creation. A baby helicoprion is called a ''hatchling''.

As with all non-vermin sea creatures, capturing a helicoprion requires a modified [[drowning chamber]]. This can be used as a source of [[meat]], though it is to be noted that the helicoprion is a cartilaginous fish(similarly to sharks and rays), which means it has no [[bones]] and will instead drop useless [[cartilage]].

Some dwarves like helicoprion for their ''tooth whorl''.
